doc: Test fixture: a full shader with per-instance params, a texture read in both stages and its own shadow program (the default prepass stays on).

tint.doc: Colour of the mesh. One value per entity.

raise.doc: Lift of every vertex along the world up axis, in metres. One value per entity.

boost.doc: Multiplies the colour. One value per draw.

height.doc: Height map: a tenth of the red channel lifts a vertex, in metres.
